content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Blackthorn | Payments Admin ## slug: blackthorn-payments-admin ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The Blackthorn | Payments Admin tab helps you manage the Payments app's settings. Each section below matches the corresponding tab. ## Batch Jobs Most of the [batch jobs are scheduled](/v1/docs/scheduled-batch-jobs) to run nightly, but you can start any of the following Payments batch jobs immediatly by clicking the relevant button. ### Rollup Transaction to Parent Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Transaction Rollup To Parent * Runs every 30 minutes.. * Updates a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s parent records with the (child) {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s summary. This includes Payouts, Captures, Transfers, Refunds, and the Total fields on the parent record. ### Process Scheduled Charge Transactions Now Button Clicking this button starts two different batch processes. * The Blackthorn | Payments Daily Captures batch job processes all Authorized Charges ({{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = “Authorized”) with {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = “Open”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} = “True”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_DateProcess}} = “Today”, and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = “Normal”. * The Blackthorn | Payments Daily Captures (Authorized) batch job processes all Charges with {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = “Open”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} = “True”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_DateProcess}} = “Today”, and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = “Normal”. See [Process Charge Scheduled Transactions and Reattempt Logic](/v1/docs/transaction-reattempt-logic) for more information. ### Process Scheduled Refund Transactions Now Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Daily Refunds * Clicking this button starts a batch job that processes all Charges with the following: a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = “Open”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_AutoProcess}} = “True”, {{variable.Field_Transaction_DateProcess}} = “Today”, and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = “Refund”. ### Process Payout Balance History Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Set Payout * Connects all Payout records with related Charge and Transfer (Stripe Connect) records. ### Update Balances Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Balance Update * Update the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} balances for all {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s and Connect accounts. ### Assign Default Payment Methods Button * Assign the {{variable.Object_Account}}/{{variable.Object_Contact}}'s default {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} to all related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s with {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Open". ### Update Transaction Net Amount Button * Updates the {{variable.Field_Transaction_NetAmount}} field on a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record when {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = “Stripe”. ### Update Invoices Button * Batch Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Past Due Invoices Stripe Billing * Runs daily at 5:00 am. * Updates the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Past Due" when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} Jobs > Scheduled Jobs. All of our job names start with Blackthorn | Payments. {{snippet.Payment_ChangeScheduleApexUser}} ### Schedule Transaction Rollup To Parent Job Button * Scheduled Job Name: Blackthorn | Payments Transaction Rollup To Parent * Runs every 30 minutes. * Updates a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s parent records with the (child) {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s summary. This includes Payouts, Captures, Transfers, Refunds, and the Total fields on the parent record. ### Schedule Billing Jobs Button Clicking this button will automatically schedule all billing-related [jobs](https://docs.blackthorn.io/v1/docs/blackthorn-scheduled-jobs) if they are not already scheduled. You can see a list of our scheduled jobs at Setup > Jobs > Scheduled Jobs. All of our job names start with Blackthorn | Payments. #### Scheduled Jobs * Blackthorn | Payments Send Stripe Invoices * Runs daily at 6:00 am. * Sends an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to a customer when {{variable.Field_Invoice_SendOnDate}} = "TODAY". * Blackthorn | Payments Past Due Invoices * Runs daily at 5:00 am. * Updates the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Past Due" when the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DueDate}} < Today and {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Unpaid". * The {{variable.Button_UpdateInvoices}} button is located on the Blackthorn | Payments Admin’s Batch Jobs tab #### Batch Jobs * Re-calculate Account Revenue * Recalculates the Historic Account Values (from {{variable.Object_Transaction}}) and MRR/QRR/ARR (from {{variable.Object_Subscription}}). * Rollup Transactions to Sales Document (Invoice) * Rolls up {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s to their related {{variable.Object_Invoice}} (Sales Document). ### Schedule High Volume Transaction Job Button Clicking the **Schedule High Volume Transaction Job** button will trigger the “Blackthorn | Payments Daily Captures – High Volume” scheduled job and schedule Transaction auto-charge batches using the batch size of 75. * The **Schedule High Volume Transaction Job** button is available when the auto charge batch size exceeds 1. * The **Schedule Billing Jobs** button is visible when Stripe Billing is enabled through a future date. * The **Schedule High Volume Transaction Job** button is hidden when the batch size resets to 1. * When the **Schedule High Volume Transaction Job** button is clicked, the Blackthorn | Payments Daily Captures - High Volume scheduled job will replace the Blackthorn | Payments Daily Captures job and will run at midnight. ## Upgrade We sometimes add metadata changes that are not updated when you upgrade to the latest Payments package. You can deploy the latest metadata with the click of a button. ### Enable All Record Types Button Clicking this button updates all Profiles so they have visibility and all Payments' objects so they have the correct default Record Type. ### Add Virtual Terminal Buttons Button Use this button to add the {{variable.Button_VirtualTerminal}} button to all parent objects that were configured in the Setup Wizard. ### Deploy Roll-up Fields Button Clicking this button deploys summary fields onto your {{variable.Object_Transaction}} parent objects. For example, if you defined the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} object as your {{variable.Object_Transaction}} parent, the following group of summary fields will be created on the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} object. * {{variable.Field_Invoice_CapturChargCount}} (Captured_Charge_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_CapturedCharges}} (Captured_Charges__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_CaptuTransfCount}} (Captured_Transfer_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_CapturedTransfer}} (Captured_Transfers__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_ComplPayoutCount}} (Completed_Payout_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_CompletedPayouts}} (Completed_Payouts__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenChargeCount}} (Open_Charge_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenCharges}} (Open_Charges__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenPayoutCount}} (Open_Payout_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenPayouts}} (Open_Payouts__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenTransfeCount}} (Open_Transfer_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_OpenTransfers}} (Open_Transfers__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RefundChargCount}} (Refunded_Charge_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RefundedCharges}} (Refunded_Charges__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RetainChargCount}} (Retained_Charge_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RetainedCharges}} (Retained_Charges__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RetainTransfeCnt}} (Retained_Transfer_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_RetainedTransfer}} (Retained_Tranfers__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_ReverseTransfCnt}} (Reversed_Transfer_Count__c) * {{variable.Field_Invoice_ReversedTransfer}} (Reversed Transfers__c) ### Enable Order to Invoice Button * This button will deploy an {{variable.Field_Invoice_Order}} lookup on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} object so you can easily create {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s from {{variable.Object_Order}} records. ### Add Payment Fields to Page Layouts Button * Use this button to make sure the recommended {{variable.Product_Payments}} fields are visible on all our page layouts. ({{variable.Product_Salesforce}} doesn't add new fields to page layouts when upgrading a package.) ### Add Picklist Values Button * Click this button to ensure the recommended picklist values are visible for the following fields. * {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} on {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} on {{variable.Object_Transaction}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} on {{variable.Object_Transaction}} * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Source}} on {{variable.Object_Transaction}} * {{variable.Field_Invoice_Status}} on {{variable.Object_Invoice}} * {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} on {{variable.Object_Invoice}} * {{variable.Field_CheckoutSub_Status}} on {{variable.Object_CheckoutSubmission}} * {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} on {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} * {{variable.Field_Subscrip_ProratiBehavior}} on {{variable.Object_Subscription}} * {{variable.Field_Subscrip_Status}} on {{variable.Object_Subscription}} ## Stripe Billing The following jobs are only scheduled for customers who previously had Stripe Billing enabled for their org. (We do not support Stripe Billing for new customers.) To schedule each job individually, click the following buttons on the Blackthorn | Payments Admin Stripe Billing tab. ### Deploy Stripe Billing Button * Use this button to deploy the necessary fields to use Stripe Billing in a Salesforce org. ### Re-Calculate Account Revenue Button * Clicking this button will recalculate the Historic Account Values (from {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s) and MRR/QRR/ARR (from {{variable.Object_Subscription}}s). ### Rollup Transaction to Invoice Button * Use this button to roll up {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s to their related {{variable.Object_Invoice}} (Sales Document). View our [Stripe Billing documentation](/v1/docs/stripe-billing-overview) here. * * * **If you have any questions regarding the configurations/settings, please contact [Blackthorn Support](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/blackthorn-support), and we'll help you out!**
